consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the standout performance of the night was 'So Many Roads,' which many consider to be one of the best versions ever played. While some noted Jerry's declining vocal quality, the emotional weight of the songs, particularly 'Days Between,' resonated deeply with the audience.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 25 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While 'So Many Roads' received universal acclaim, the overall performance was marred by concerns over Jerry's vocal health and a perceived lack of energy in the rest of the show.
